title: [Foundation] Enable main branch protection and required checks
body:
## Goal
Protect `main` and converge on the approved branch model.

## Required state
- pull request required before merge
- `rocksoul-gate` required
- no force push or protected-branch deletion
- squash merge preferred
- long-lived branches only `main` and `dev`
- human work only `feature/*`; transient `dependabot/*` is the bot exception
- remove legacy `chore/*` refs once unique work is ruled out

## Acceptance
GitHub reports the ruleset/protection active and branch inventory conforms.

title: [Foundation] Choose and add an explicit repository license
body:
## Decision
RockSoul uses **Apache-2.0**.

## Implemented on repository-platform branch
- root `LICENSE` contains Apache License 2.0
- Cargo workspace declares `license = "Apache-2.0"`
- crates inherit workspace license metadata
- README and Template Guide document the license and third-party provenance boundary

## Acceptance
Close after the licensed state is merged to `main` and GitHub detects the repository license.

title: [Foundation] Activate public Project, Wiki and repository sync
body:
## Goal
Activate privileged GitHub surfaces from the existing `rocksoul-sync` plane.

## Target
- public Project `rocksoul` with Kanban, Roadmap and Backlog
- Priority + Phase fields from canonical labels
- Wiki / Archive mirrored from `/docs`
- Pages / Codex deployed from `public/`
- repository description/homepage/topics/template/discussions/merge settings synchronized

## Activation
`ROCKSOUL_GITHUB_TOKEN` must provide Projects plus sufficient repository Administration/Wiki/Pages access.

## Acceptance
Project, Wiki, Pages and repository settings are observed from GitHub after the `main` sync; Issues + labels + milestones remain canonical.

title: [Foundation] Commit Cargo.lock for reproducible application builds
body:
## Goal
Treat RockSoul as an application workspace with reproducible dependency resolution.

## Acceptance
- root `Cargo.lock` is tracked
- CI/RustSec use the committed resolution
- Dependabot/Cargo updates modify the lockfile intentionally.

title: [Foundation] Configure GitHub repository metadata and topics
body:
## Goal
Keep repository About metadata aligned with the World Entry and governance contract.

## Acceptance
Description, homepage, focused topics, template/discussions/wiki/project settings, squash-only merge preference and merged-branch deletion are verified without AGI/ASI overclaiming.

title: [Foundation] Connect canonical Web mirror to Vercel
body:
## Goal
Use Vercel as the canonical Live World Portal for `public/` without creating another frontend source.

## Verified evidence — 2026-09-09
- Vercel project `rocksoul` is linked directly to GitHub repo `bjo163/rocksoul`
- production deployment from `main` reports READY
- stable portal domain is recorded in `public/brand.env`
- `feature/repo-platform` previews report READY and include PR #22 + exact commit SHAs in deployment metadata

## Acceptance
Close after the repository-platform merge produces a READY production deployment containing the merged World Portal.

title: [Foundation] Inventory World Nodes and route eligible CI workloads
body:
## Goal
Build an evidence-backed inventory of self-hosted runners available to this repository, then route only suitable workloads.

## Required inventory
Runner name/labels, OS, architecture, Rust/Node/Python availability, Docker capability, network class and intended workload.

## Evidence rule
Do not show ONLINE/READY/BUSY/OFFLINE or change `runs-on` blindly. The current connector cannot read the authenticated Actions runner inventory, so public workflow evidence alone is insufficient.

## Acceptance
Authorized inventory is captured without secrets, capabilities are documented, routing/fallback is explicit, and UI node state comes from actual runner/job evidence.

title: [Phase A] Persist birth identity and append-only lifecycle journal
body:
## Goal
Make birth and lifecycle restart-safe.

## Scope
Persist identity/birth, append-only lifecycle journal, derive chronological age, recovery tests.

## Acceptance
Restart never creates a new birth; corruption fails explicitly; CI remains green.

title: [Phase B] Implement World Graph, discovery state and Ratatui map
body:
## Goal
Turn the existing presentation/topology contract into persistent World state.

## Existing foundation
`public/world.json`, Web World Map and Ratatui MAP already model topology/evidence but are not the persistent World Graph.

## Acceptance
Place/entity/relation/discovery/provenance/trust state is serializable, testable and renderable without coupling cognition to either UI.

title: [Phase C] Implement persistent four-part memory system
body:
## Goal
Implement working, episodic, semantic and procedural memory with persistence, provenance, freshness and supersession.

## Acceptance
Memory types remain distinct and retrieval is deterministic/testable; pgvector is added only when evidence warrants it.

title: [Phase D] Integrate RockSoul Nano behind a stable Rust Brain interface
body:
## Goal
Consume a versioned Nano artifact from `rocksoul-mind` behind a stable Rust Brain contract.

## Acceptance
Production inference needs no Python service and model swaps do not change higher cognition contracts.

title: [Phase E] Build deterministic Skills / Yad executor
body:
## Goal
Give RockSoul controlled action capability through deterministic typed tools.

## Acceptance
Every skill has validated input, bounded execution, explicit result/error output, audit metadata and no hidden authority escalation.

title: [Phase F] Implement the Global Cognitive Workspace and finite executive loop
body:
## Goal
Replace transcript-only cognition with structured goals, facts, beliefs, unknowns, hypotheses, evidence, plans, actions, observations, confidence and budgets.

## Acceptance
Facts/beliefs/hypotheses stay distinct and every executive loop has finite step/tool/replan/time/cost/risk budgets.

title: [Phase G] Implement Tabayyun / Guardian verification and authority gates
body:
## Goal
Make verification, provenance, risk and authorization first-class runtime gates.

## Invariant
Intelligence never implies authority.

## Acceptance
Consequential actions cannot bypass deterministic policy even when a model suggests them.

title: [Phase H] Implement missions, validated XP, level, cognitive age and trust progression
body:
## Goal
Turn progression into measurable evaluation rather than decorative game numbers.

## Acceptance
Unvalidated activity earns no success XP; age candidates can be rejected/regressed; Trust never bypasses policy.

title: [Phase I] Integrate evidence-selected RockSoul Cortex
body:
## Goal
Integrate the reasoning/planning Cortex selected by evidence from `rocksoul-mind` (rough research target 300–600M, not a fixed promise).

## Acceptance
Measured reasoning/planning gains justify runtime cost and reuse the same World/memory/evidence contracts.

title: [Phase J] Add on-demand Shura multi-perspective reasoning
body:
## Goal
Use bounded multiple perspectives only when complexity warrants it.

## Non-goal
No permanent agent swarm.

## Acceptance
Explicit trigger, shared evidence/workspace, bounded cost and measured benefit over single-Cortex reasoning.

title: [Phase K] Build policy-gated autonomous research loops
body:
## Goal
Support finite goal → research → hypothesis → experiment/code → observe → verify → report loops.

## Acceptance
Loops are budgeted, interruptible, auditable, evidence-grounded and permission-gated.

title: [Phase L] Design controlled collective intelligence
body:
## Goal
Share verified World knowledge and validated experience between controlled instances.

## Acceptance
Identity, provenance, trust boundaries, conflict resolution, staleness and revocation exist before cross-instance learning.

title: [Phase M] Define empirical ASI research gate and evaluation protocol
body:
## Goal
Define evidence required before any ASI classification is considered.

## Invariant
Age, level, parameter count, autonomy, agents or branding are not evidence of ASI.

## Acceptance
Evaluation requires broad, reproducible, adversarially tested superiority beyond top human performance across relevant domains.
